messages.subject: Install and CpG context
parts:
Hi all

Sorry for the stupid questions, but I'm struggling to get methylKit to install from Github. Here's the error I'm getting and a sessionInfo() below.

I'm also struggling to work out if methylKit can analyse the CpG context file I have, that looks like it might have been made with an old version of Bismark. It has no strand info, only chromosome, position, methylatedCounts, unmethylatedCounts values. Which function will read this in correctly for me?

Massive thanks for any help you can offer.

Matt

On Tue, Jun 14, 2016 at 12:45 PM, Matt Burney <8ur...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all

Sorry for the stupid questions, but I'm struggling to get methylKit to install from Github. Here's the error I'm getting and a sessionInfo() below.
This could be a devtools error, I'm not sure. It works for me, but I'm using the latest R 3.3.0

I'm also struggling to work out if methylKit can analyse the CpG context file I have, that looks like it might have been made with an old version of Bismark. It has no strand info, only chromosome, position, methylatedCounts, unmethylatedCounts values. Which function will read this in correctly for me?
This may be a bismark coverage file. If so, you can use pipeline='bismarkCoverage' in methRead() function.

Massive thanks for any help you can offer.

Matt
